people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.bsb: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
translations.kjv: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.asv: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
